f59aee00a916248d7022042ff6cb62b68e94dd29.summary: A DataBreaches report, published 2023-12-03, on an extortion claim by the AlphV (aka BlackCat) group against Tipalti, a financial technology firm providing accounts payable and payments software. AlphV said it had exfiltrated over 265GB of data since September 2023, claimed an insider was involved, and planned to extort Tipalti, Roblox and Twitch. It posted no proof of its claims. Tipalti said it was investigating the allegation and had not detected any data loss or breach. The report stresses that AlphV's claims are unconfirmed.

f57f1bde5e9e4b6c2eea46bb6bae72501b7be4e3.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that financially motivated actors, including Storm-0569, Storm-1113, Sangria Tempest and Storm-1674, abused the App Installer (ms-appinstaller) protocol handler from mid-November 2023 to distribute malware, often leading to ransomware. Lures included spoofed software download pages, malicious MSIX packages and phishing through Microsoft Teams. Microsoft disabled the handler by default and published mitigations and detection names.

f55aa43267656bd2c14f2bec3bcab99fc296bdc0.summary: An Anomali-authored 2017 overview of Russia's state-linked cyber and information-warfare landscape. It covers the GRU, FSB and SVR, the APT28 and APT29 groups, Russian-based organised crime, hacktivist fronts, disinformation and bot campaigns, and predicted 2017 targets (European elections, the Balkans, the Baltic states and fallout from US sanctions). Much of it is drawn from third-party reporting and forecasts.
